facts.text: The hotel has been around since 1899.
facts.excerpt: This hotel has been around since 1899.

facts.text: An extensive renovation completed in 2008 carried the historic building into the 21st century.
facts.excerpt: An extensive renovation completed in 2008 carried the historic building into the 21st century.

facts.text: Guests move from the castle-like main building into sleek dark gray-glass wings.
facts.excerpt: as you move from the castle-like main building into the sleek dark gray-glass wings

facts.text: The hotel has an art gallery with over 100 pieces from 90 artists, including Botero, Dali, Haring and Murakami.
facts.excerpt: There's even an art gallery inside this hotel, with over 100 pieces from 90 artists including Botero, Dalí, Haring, and Murakami.

facts.text: A funicular beside the hotel runs into the city center.
facts.excerpt: hoping on the little funicular beside the hotel and riding into the city center

facts.text: The hotel is not in the walkable heart of the city; guests use the valet car or the shuttle to reach Zurich.
facts.excerpt: This isn’t a walkable heart-of-the-city type of spot—at the Dolder, you're on high, but you can grab your car from the valet or hop on the shuttle

facts.text: The spa covers 4,000 square meters.
facts.excerpt: Our multi-award-winning spa world offers a unique range of well-being on 4,000 square meters.

facts.text: The Ladies' Spa and the Gentlemen's Spa each have a sauna, steam bath, foot bath, aroma pool, steam pots, plunge pool and solarium.
facts.excerpt: are each equipped with a sauna, steam bath, foot bath, aroma pool, steam pots, plunge pool and solarium

facts.text: The Aqua Zone has a swimming pool, whirlpools, a sanarium, a snow paradise, a steam bath and an outdoor sun terrace.
facts.excerpt: The Aqua Zone offers a 25 meter long swimming pool, whirlpools, sanarium, snow paradise, steam bath and outdoor sun terrace.

facts.text: The spa has a meditation room with a dome made of mirror mosaic.
facts.excerpt: You will find meditative calm in our meditation room with its fascinating dome made of mirror mosaic.

facts.text: Children are welcome in the spa from the age of twelve.
facts.excerpt: Children are welcome from the age of twelve.

facts.text: The spa offers two private Spa Suites, each with a steam bath, whirlpool, balcony and fireplace.
facts.excerpt: offers two 70-m2 Spa Suites, each equipped with two treatment couches and a steam bath, whirlpool, snail shower, reclining area, balcony, fireplace and TV

facts.text: The Restaurant by Heiko Nieder is Michelin-starred.
facts.excerpt: a gourmet menu at the Michelin-starred The Restaurant by Chef Fine Dining Heiko Nieder

facts.text: A Chef's Table sits in the heart of the kitchen, where guests follow the creation of each dish.
facts.excerpt: exclusively at the Chef’s Table in the heart of the kitchen and follow the creation of each dish

facts.text: Saltz restaurant has a patio and serves dishes like Zurich-style veal and rosti.
facts.excerpt: In warmer months, the patio is reason alone to visit; in winter, you'll see guests cozying up over dishes like Zurich style veal and rösti

facts.text: The lobby serves a traditional English Afternoon Tea.
facts.excerpt: while we serve you the traditional English Afternoon Tea

facts.text: In the evening a DJ plays at the Canvas Bar and bartenders mix signature drinks such as the Dolder Negroni.
facts.excerpt: In the evening, not only our DJ but also our bartenders mix classic cocktails and our signature drinks, such as “Dolder Negroni”

facts.text: The Canvas Bar was voted the best hotel bar in Switzerland in 2023.
facts.excerpt: In 2023, the Canvas Bar was voted the best hotel bar in Switzerland.

facts.text: Weekly live music acts at the hotel are a fixture in Zurich's music calendar.
facts.excerpt: The weekly live music acts at the Dolder Grand have become a firm fixture in Zurich’s music calendar.

facts.text: Every Junior Suite Grand has a panoramic view of the city of Zurich, the lake and the Swiss mountains.
facts.excerpt: Every Junior Suite Grand is guaranteed to offer an impressive panoramic view of the city of Zurich, the lake and the Swiss mountains.

facts.text: Junior suite bathrooms have a whirlpool bathtub and a separate walk-in shower.
facts.excerpt: The bathrooms are furnished with a whirlpool bathtub and separate walk-in shower.

facts.text: Rooms in the new wings have a sleeker feel with chrome details and white leather.
facts.excerpt: In the new wings, though, expect a sleeker feel brought on by chrome details and white leather

facts.text: The fitness facilities are accessible to hotel guests 24 hours a day.
facts.excerpt: Accessible for hotel guests 24 hours a day

facts.text: At Christmas, Belgian designer Charles Kaisin transforms the hotel with 1,200 golden origami doves.
facts.excerpt: Belgian designer Charles Kaisin returns, transforming the hotel with 1,200 golden origami doves

facts.text: The hotel does not especially cater to kids, but families would not feel out of place.
facts.excerpt: I wouldn't say the hotel itself caters to kids, but you wouldn't feel out of place either.
